requiredFindings.title: A capped network backoff can still perpetually deny unrelated eligible accounts
requiredFindings.finding: resources.rate counts all attempted control starts in one trusted-network bucket. resources.delay proposes network-window excess blocks of10/20/30seconds and resets only after a full no-excess window. Saying blocked requests do not push an individual block farther does not prevent fresh blocks at each expiry while attempted starts keep the rolling window above120. The statement that one network must not perpetually lock unrelated accounts supplies no admission/fairness exception that can satisfy that requirement.
requiredFindings.scenario: Two unrelated eligible staff accounts and an unauthenticated/stale requester share one trusted network bucket, such as a common NAT. The requester continuously exceeds120 attempted starts per60seconds. At each block expiry, excess persists and the next request can trigger another capped30second block; existing legitimate accounts can remain unable to obtain CSRF, renew or logout indefinitely even when their own session/principal budgets are available. A maximum single block duration is not a maximum denial duration under sustained shared-bucket traffic.
requiredFindings.impact: A malicious or faulty requester sharing the network bucket can cause an indefinite account-control denial for unrelated staff. This is a proposed contract discrepancy, not a claim of an implemented exploit or a guarantee against volumetric infrastructure exhaustion.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Define a finite, bounded authenticated admission/fairness rule so network excess alone cannot perpetually exclude unrelated current eligible sessions/principals. Preserve trusted network counting and progressive delay, the global work/crypto budget, current verification before identity-keyed allocation, session/principal limits and fail-closed unknown accounting. Do not merely increase120/30, assert eventual fairness, remove network controls or create an unbounded fallback/queue. Specify what remains available and under what bounded verified admission when the shared network is continuously excessive.
requiredFindings.boundary: Local proposal refinement under existing SEC-006; no new business grant. Any new lane/reservation/quota tradeoff must be explicit, finite and independently reviewed before adoption; a material architecture/cost/risk alternative retains the applicable founder boundary.
futureOracles: Sustained invalid/retired traffic in a shared network bucket cannot indefinitely exclude unrelated already-eligible accounts solely because the network excess counter remains high.
Legitimate session/principal counters and crypto/current-authority/global capacity stay bounded; unverified selectors allocate no identity-keyed state.
Distributed workers/tabs/rotations observe the same staged backoff/admission policy; abort/block expiry cannot reset active counters or free unsettled work.
requiredFindings.scopeLimit: This does not require unlimited service under global saturation or immunity to all network denial attacks. It requires the controlled shared-network rule itself to meet its accepted non-perpetual-account-lock constraint.

Current or renewal-due credential may inspect its own current control state; due never regains business output/tickets. Prior can only use protected renewal recovery within the original bounded window with existing current CSRF. It cannot bootstrap CSRF/status or logout an eligible current successor. Expired/wrong-kind/invalid-signature tokens are denied, no decode-only or long-lived refresh family. Prior without in-memory proof needs deliberate sign-in.

Current early calls re-deliver original claims/identity/times; due creates exactly one successor; prior recovers the existing successor, notC. Candidate explicitly preserves the reviewed same-session successor protection. Retired/prior token with eligible successor and stale/missing proof receives403 without Set-Cookie or revocation; authentic stale presentation alone is no principal/session kill authority. Separately authorized compromise workflow remains independent.

Eligible current (including due) logout requires current proof/source, exact-session guarded invalidation before204/clear. Valid-origin/control absent-cookie or fully known terminal/absent-session cases are explicit harmless no-ops with no server-session revocation claim. Authentic prior resolving to an active successor cannot use that exception. Malformed/expired JWT403 is compatible with harmless idempotency rather than universal204. reviewedAssessments.topic: Exact proposed claims and token expiry
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Eight exact minimal claims exclude roles/identity-provider claims/content/secrets; private mapped principal/session/token UUIDs remain linkable protected metadata. Fixed issuer/single audience/exact type and current server matching prevent payload grants. iat=nbf floor issuance and exp floor original absolute deadline fix the previously open expiry candidate without resetting it on renewal; precise current issuance/session/idle/renewal checks remain stricter. Flooring may shorten by a fractional second but cannot extend original access; no nonpositive lifetime or expired-JWT recovery. This is proposed mapping requiring adoption, not previously approved exp policy.

Bounded compact canonical-base64url JWS, closed strictUTF8 header/claims, duplicate/BOM/scalar/numeric-alias refusal and trusted algorithm/key/type/issuer/audience/current mapping are independent boundaries. Qualified library built-ins verify full signatures; raw shape alone is no JWT verifier. Exact alg/kid inventory/header encoding/signature-family bound/key custody and compatibility graph remain held, so no token-selected key URL, none/decode-only or mixed-family fallback is implied.

GET no query/body; POST bounded closed{} JSON, strict framing/media, fixed minimal errors and bodyless transport separation are prospective.204 omits content type/length; body-bearing UTF8/1024byte limits and no-store/nosniff remain. Only success renewal/logout set exact cookie; reads/errors do not. Final current authority/source/copy and physical writer fences apply, with no DB-commit-as-network proof. Already admitted effects/bytes cannot be undone or relabeled by control loss.

Global32 control permits reserved before route-owned receiving/auth and held through known drain preserve OPWIRE01 sequencing. No per-route pool/hidden queue; current eligibility precedes one-in-flight/session/principal key allocation.10session/30principal/120network starts,1024/256/4096keys and2/5/10second targets are new unmeasured proposals. No active-key eviction/reset or unsettled release. SSCTRL01 must resolve network fairness; actual address grouping/privacy/physical memory/Redis/distributed accounting stays held.

Status/current-proof initialization, one due status/renewal/confirmation and one retained-proof recovery/status are finite logical actions, not polling/catch-up/auto429/business retry. Auth/context loss drops private transient material and stale replies; no clock activity or caller-selected context authority. Session metadata/counter network mapping retains existing protected purposes; exact trusted grouping/pseudonymization is not selected. Full-process warning/focus/recovery/accessibility remains required.
